$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support

aliases.description:
Named aliases for `kyz exec`. Each alias resolves a set of secrets
to inject as environment variables when wrapping a process.

history_retention.description:
Maximum number of history versions to retain per secret entry.
Older versions are discarded on each update. Set to 0 to disable history.

paths.description: Custom paths for data and state directories.

scripts.description: Pinned script grants for `kyz run` (grant name → definition).

AliasConfig.description: Named alias for kyz exec secret injection

env_map.description:
Explicit env-var mappings: `{ "ENV_VAR" = "service/key:field" }`.

These override the default field-name uppercasing for specific fields.

tags.description: Tags to match. All secrets with *any* of these tags are included.

DaemonConfig.description: Credential daemon lifecycle and listener configuration

listen.description: Loopback SocketAddr for the HTTP credential proxy listener

request_body_limit_bytes.description: Maximum accepted request body size in bytes.

response_body_limit_bytes.description: Maximum accepted response body size in bytes.

timeout_secs.description:
Daemon lifetime in seconds. 0 means run until `kyz daemon stop`,
crash, or reboot. This is independent of vault session timeouts.

LogLevel.description: Log level enumeration for schema validation.

oneOf.description: Emit all messages including fine-grained traces.

file.description: Optional path for log file output. Supports ~ and environment variables.

level.description: Log level (error, warn, info, debug, trace).

PathsConfig.description: Custom paths for data and state directories

data_dir.description: Directory for persistent data. Supports ~ and environment variables.

state_dir.description: Directory for state files. Supports ~ and environment variables.

oneOf.description: No proxy authentication (loopback only; same-user attacks remain).

rules.description:
Routing rules. Matching semantics and validation live in
[`crate::proxy_config`].

ProxyCredentialConfig.description: Credential binding for a proxy rule

alias.description: Unique alias within the rule, used as `{{alias.field}}` in templates.

fields.description: Fields this credential is allowed to resolve (explicit allowlist).

key.description: Vault key of the secret entry.

service.description: Vault service namespace of the secret entry.

credentials.description: Credentials this rule may resolve, referenced by alias from templates.

headers.description:
Header templates. Values support literal text plus `{{alias.field}}`
substitutions only.

host.description:
Host this rule matches after normalization. Exact hostname or a
left-side single-label wildcard (`*.example.com`).

methods.description:
Allowed HTTP methods. Defaults to common API methods. `CONNECT` and
`TRACE` are rejected regardless of this list.

name.description: Unique rule name (used in audit events).

path_prefix.description: Path prefix this rule matches (longest prefix wins). Defaults to `/`.

static_headers.description: Static headers added verbatim (no templates allowed here).

strip.description: Client headers stripped before credential injection.

upstream.description: Upstream base URL. Must be `https://` without userinfo.

parallelism.description: Worker pool size. Defaults to logical CPU count when unset.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for long-running operations (default: 60).

ScriptGrantConfig.description: Pinned script grant for kyz run

env.description:
Environment the grant may receive: `ENV_VAR -> "service/key:field"`.
This map is the entire permission boundary — fields not listed are
never exposed to the script.

path.description: Canonical absolute path of the script.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the script contents (64 characters).
